system.description:
Institutional ties that open doors, grant access, or carry weight.

  • Level 1: Associated (e.g. student rep, police officer)
  • Level 2: Respected (e.g. sergeant, small biz owner)
  • Level 3: Modest Authority (e.g. lieutenant, mayor)
  • Level 4: Local Authority (e.g. captain, knight with land)
  • Level 5: Regional Authority (e.g. colonel, baron)
  • Level 6: Provincial Authority (e.g. senator, VP)
  • Level 7: National Authority (e.g. king, cabinet official)
  • Level 8: International Authority (e.g. president, pope)
  • Level 9: Planetary Authority (e.g. world ruler)
  • Level 10: Extraplanetary Authority (e.g. galactic emperor)
